title: Equi-Tuning: Group Equivariant Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as its fairness experiments focused exclusively on gender, race, and sexual orientation. The only mention of a religious group is in a cited reference regarding 'anti-Muslim bias' in other work.
